name: phil/comments-bundle
description: Comments for Symfony on a whole page or on a passage of a text, with suggested replacements: in a UJO (Universal JSON Output) document, anchors that follow edits and mark a vanished passage orphaned; threads, authors as resource references, Doctrine storage, JSON endpoints and a Stimulus controller

suggest.phil/block-editor-bundle: For the block editor whose selection the controller comments on
suggest.phil/mentions-bundle: For the @ autocomplete on the text areas of the panel, and the mentions of comments
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes the comments on a whole page draw — Alert, Badge, Button, Card, Field, Textarea —, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To serve the controller and its stylesheet without a build step
suggest.symfony/routing: For the endpoints, and their URLs given to the controller
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the comments on a whole page drawn by the server, with plain forms and the recipes of the PHIL UX kit
